pages.text:
Pipe and filter architecture
• Functional transformations process their inputs to produce outputs.
• May be referred to as a pipe and ﬁlter model (as in UNIX shell).
• e.g.) cat 2021-03-31.log | grep "error" | wc -l
• Variants of this approach are very common.
• When transformations are sequential, this is a batch sequential model
which is extensively used in data processing systems.
• Not really suitable for interactive systems.

pages.text: An example of the pipe and filter architecture used in a payments system
pages.description: 글자는 제목뿐이고 흐름도 그림 하나가 있다(결제 시스템의 파이프 앤 필터). 둥근 상자는 필터(처리), 네모 상자는 데이터다. 흐름: 데이터 Invoices → 필터 Read issued invoices → 필터 Identify payments(데이터 Payments도 여기로 들어감) → 두 갈래. 위 갈래: Issue receipts → 데이터 Receipts. 아래 갈래: Find payments due → Issue payment reminder → 데이터 Reminders. 원본 페이지 기준 위치 [x, y, w, h]: 흐름도 전체 [0.11, 0.35, 0.78, 0.42], Read issued invoices [0.12, 0.46, 0.13, 0.10], Invoices [0.12, 0.64, 0.13, 0.11], Identify payments [0.27, 0.46, 0.13, 0.10], Payments [0.27, 0.64, 0.13, 0.11], Issue receipts [0.45, 0.36, 0.12, 0.10], Receipts [0.59, 0.36, 0.13, 0.10], Find payments due [0.45, 0.54, 0.12, 0.14], Issue payment reminder [0.59, 0.54, 0.13, 0.14], Reminders [0.75, 0.56, 0.13, 0.10].
